title: Steady week: 4 applications, 2 interviews
body:
> [!] Replies came only from jobs posted under 5 days ago

You sent 4 applications and had two interviews.

Interviews ask for patient stories — 3 applications, 2 employers

- Polyclinique des Canuts · interview review: Asked twice about acute situations

### What worked

- Applying within 5 days of posting: 3 of 4 replied

### Change next week

- Send the 5 drafted kits

### Focus

Five applications to fresh postings

### Numbers

- Applications: 12 total, 4 this week; interview rate of decided 33%
- Market: 186 open jobs, 120 in your places, 31 new this week
